Plugin.Name: Bay Watch
Plugin.Overview: Every bay needs a lifeguard. Bay Watch maps your physical drive bays, hot-swap trays, and PCIe NVMe carriers to a visual tray map, with per-drive array/pool role, capacity, manufacturer branding, and SMART health history over time (no slow-motion running required). Formerly Disk Location Next. It is an independent project, not affiliated with the Disk Location plugin or its author. Built as a standalone service against Unraid's native unraid-api (Unraid 7.2+) instead of a classic PHP webGUI plugin.
